The Williams fit was characterized at −80 to −10 mV and 0.34–5.5 mW/mm², with temperature scaling fitted at 22 and 37 °C. This neuron's resting and action-potential voltages include mathematical extrapolation outside that voltage range.

opsinExtrapolation.statement: Fit retained exactly, including voltage extrapolation and photon-loss factor 1.3. Not an experimentally calibrated optical threshold.

diagnostics.eventDefinition: Upward soma crossing of −25 mV, interpolated at integration resolution, with a 2 ms event refractory interval.
diagnostics.outputConvention: States at saved physical times; lightDrive is right-continuous. Pulses split integration timesteps at their exact boundaries. Instantaneous nonlinear photocurrent is evaluated from saved channel state and voltage.
diagnostics.operatorConvention: Native membrane state at t drives backward-Euler voltage at t+dt; opsin and native gates then advance using new voltage. ChR2 current is tangent-linearized at old voltage; its maximum current discrepancy is reported.
